tagline: Rotorua's STIHL dealer for equipment, parts and service
heroSubheading: STIHL equipment, parts and service for Rotorua
aboutHtml:
We're STIHL SHOP Rotorua, supplying and servicing STIHL equipment for locals who know quality. Alan and Phillip Richards built this place to be the hub for anyone who needs dependable outdoor gear that works hard.

We sell STIHL chainsaws, trimmers, blowers and more. We stock genuine parts and servicing supplies to keep your equipment running strong. We service what we sell and give straight advice on choosing the right tool for your job. Whether you're starting a new project or maintaining equipment you've already got, we're here to help you get it done right.

Come in and have a chat with us. We're open Monday to Friday from 8am to 5:30pm, and Saturday from 8am to 2pm. You'll find what you need here.
